messages:
Luis M.: NovaCare POC stuck, getting 401 + "scope_mismatch" for /v1/generate. They claim nothing changed on their side.
Tara (AE): can you paste the curl/SDK call (redact key) and full response body + headers? sometimes customers accidentally copy keys between orgs.
Customer: using our internal script: `python client.py --key sk-NOV-OLD --model redwood-small --prompt 'hello'` Response: `401 {"error":"scope_mismatch", "request_id": "rq_aa11bb"}` Headers include `x-rw-auth: failed` and `x-rw-rate-limit: 6000/6000`.
Kofi (eng): two quick checks: 1) run the inspect endpoint with the exact same Authorization header to see owner_org/owner_project/scopes; 2) confirm they're not accidentally sending an extra header like `X-Api-Key` or a trailing space in the token. Old scripts sometimes have `Authorization:Bearer` (missing space) which causes parsing oddities.
Customer: ran inspect -> `owner_org: nova-staging`, `owner_project: onboarding-run`, `scopes: ["embeddings:read"]`. But calls to /v1/generate should be to the POC project `novacare-prod` where they are testing.
Luis M.: yep, key bound to staging org. That explains scope mismatch when calling a POC project under a different org.
Kofi (eng): minimal repro using curl/SDK after creating a proper key:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-new-NOV" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Kofi (eng): note: some internal SDKs will auto-attach `x-rw-org` based on config; if you copy a key from a different org the SDK may still send the old `x-rw-org` header. Check your SDK config.
Harper (security): for POCs we recommend: create a scoped key with `inference:invoke` only, set an expiry (24h/7d), add IP allowlist if possible, and put a small spend cap on the project. Never promote staging keys to prod.
KeyBot: Tip: use the console -> API keys -> Create key -> select target project `novacare-poc` -> add scopes `inference:invoke` (and `chat:stream` if streaming) -> optionally set expiry and IPs.
Customer: created a new key under the correct project but still see 401; response `request_id: rq_cc22dd`, header `x-rw-auth: pending-propagation`.
Kofi (eng): that indicates auth cache propagation; wait ~20-60s after key creation and retry. If still failing, capture `request_id` and we'll trace.
Luis M.: please ask them to retry after 1 minute and share the `request_id` if it fails. Also remind them to rotate any hardcoded keys in scripts.
Customer: retried after 45s and got 200 + tokens, POC back online. Thanks everyone.
Tara (AE): I'll send a handoff note to NovaCare with a short checklist: inspect key binding, ensure scopes include `inference:invoke`, make keys in correct project, wait ~1m for propagation, set expiry & spend cap, and include `request_id` when contacting support.
Harper (security): I'll add a blurb for the security questionnaire: recommend scoped keys + expiry for POCs and guidance on IP allowlisting and service principals.
Luis M.: closing this POC blocker. Good win for the team. :white_check_mark:
